message: XVatsim 1.2.3 is available. Download the freeware Windows XP12 package from X-Plane.org or GitHub Releases.
release_notes: Fixes exact route-polygon crossing detection by refining entry across ordered boundary intervals.
Restores KZFW route ownership and FTW Center relevance on the live-tested SKJ914 MMTO-KCOS route.
Adds X-Plane.org and GitHub Releases as visible download choices in the update notice and user documentation.
Preserves brain-owned controller relevance, display order, standby assist, and route-authority guardrails.
